Grid 6 by 6. Zero-based ( row , col ). Rows increase down; columns increase right. Start ( 3 , 2 ). Goal ( 5 , 4 ). Obstacles ( 0 , 5 ) ; ( 1 , 1 ) ; ( 3 , 3 ) ; ( 3 , 4 ) ; ( 4 , 5 ).
